Patient: Ryan Carroll (DOB: 1960-08-12, MRN: SYN-6468099). 63-year-old male with newly diagnosed IgG kappa multiple myeloma (standard-risk cytogenetics, transplant-ineligible by preference) scheduled to start Cycle 1 lenalidomide 25 mg PO daily (days 1-21 of 28-day cycle) and dexamethasone 40 mg PO weekly (days 1, 8, 15, 22; total 160 mg/month) on 2024-06-05, with daratumumab to be added pending insurance approval.

Clinical Measurements & Labs (2024-05-30): Height 175 cm, Weight 104 kg, BMI = 104 / (1.75^2) = 33.96 kg/m2 (34.0 kg/m2, obesity). Labs: Creatinine 1.1 mg/dL, eGFR 71 mL/min/1.73m2, Platelets 188 x 10^3/uL, Hemoglobin 11.2 g/dL, Calcium 9.6 mg/dL. No bleeding history and no separate cardiovascular indication for antiplatelet therapy.

Thrombosis History Review: Outside hospital discharge summary from Cape Ann Regional Hospital (admitted 2019-09-29, discharged 2019-10-04) documents an acute deep vein thrombosis (DVT) of the right popliteal and posterior tibial veins following elective right total knee arthroplasty (2019-09-17), treated with 3 months of rivaroxaban. This personal VTE history was missed in the fellow's initial note.
